title: Session A · Full body
notes: Updated by the coach each week; the weights here are the plan. Every set ends with 2 reps left in the tank (the note on each exercise says so). First time: pick weights that make that true. Three pairs: A1 then A2, rest, repeat. Legs moderate: if your back or legs tighten, skip the rest of that exercise.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.note: A1. Moderate. Heels down, chest up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.note: A2. One arm, other hand and knee on the bench so your back is supported.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.note: B1. Flat bench. Elbows about 45° from your sides, not flared.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.note: B2. Bodyweight. Squeeze at the top for a second.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.note: C1. Seated, bench upright. Palms facing each other (neutral grip). If the shoulders are still sore from Tuesday, go light and keep it smooth.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.note: Finisher. Slow. Low back stays flat on the floor.
